messages:
incidents-bot: [PagerDuty] P1 - Observability ingestion gap for EnterprizeX (tenant: enterprize-x-prod) in us-west-2. Traces and per-tenant log links not showing up in tenant shard. Affected: dedicated pool dp-42 (VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d). Pager: sara_oncall_eng
sara_oncall_eng: acknowledged. paging SRE on-call. any immediate customer impact? :rotating_light:
sean_sre: seeing repeated 403s from forwarder -> s3-per-tenant-usw2 in forwarder logs. request ids like 0f8c... not present in tenant shard ingestion.
mariam_cs: EnterprizeX on support line reporting missing traces and blank spans in their dashboards for ~36m. They want ETA and mitigation.
observability-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/obs-forwarder-tenant-403. Recommended first steps: check forwarder IAM role, sink policy, and forwarder env for FALLBACK.
sean_sre: quick checks: `kubectl -n obs get pods -l tenant=enterprize-x` shows forwarder replica up but logs show `403 Forbidden: PutObject` to s3-per-tenant-usw2. IAM assume-role failing.
remy_oncall: confirmed: dp-42 uses cross-account role `redwood-forwarder-enterprizex`. Looks like a credential rotation occurred during the maintenance window and trust policy was overwritten.
sara_oncall_eng: can we provision a temporary fallback so ingestion continues while we restore role? customer needs trace continuity.
dave_platform: I can enable fallback routing to central-obs (global index) by toggling env var `FORWARDER_FALLBACK=true` on the forwarder deployment. This will cause a rolling restart. Will incur global index noise but preserves traces.
sean_sre: running these now. plan:
```
# check role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-forwarder-enterprizex --region us-west-2
# enable fallback and restart
kubectl -n obs set env deploy/forwarder FORWARDER_FALLBACK=true --record
kubectl -n obs rollout restart deploy/forwarder
```

mariam_cs: please DM me when fallback active so I can update EnterprizeX (they asked for a 15m window).
deploy-bot: started rollout for deploy/forwarder (revision: v3.2.9 -> v3.2.10) by sean_sre
sean_sre: patch applied, rollout in progress. monitoring ingestion metrics for enterprize-x in CloudWatch and internal dashboards.
observability-bot: note: central routing will not preserve per-tenant shard indexing. Traces will be available under global index with tenant tag, but some per-tenant dashboards may need manual mapping.
remy_oncall: taking over incident from sara at 22:40 UTC for handoff. @lee_oncall please own IAM reconciliation and replay verification.
lee_oncall: ack. opening quick sync with security for trust policy rebind.
sean_sre: security confirmed trust policy mismatch. re-applied trust policy and permissions to role. re-running `sts assume-role` succeeded. Forwarder 403s stopped.
sean_sre: now disabling fallback and initiating replay of missed payloads back into the tenant shard.
# replay commands
```
# on relay host
python3 /opt/relay/replay.py --tenant enterprize-x --since '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z'
```

lee_oncall: replay started, ETA ~12m for ~1h backlog. Monitoring replay metrics (events_replayed, success_rate).
mariam_cs: customer update: EnterprizeX says traces are reappearing, will validate dashboards and notify us if gaps remain.
remy_oncall: action items assigned:
- dave_platform: add alert when IAM assume-role fails for tenant forwarders and document rotation steps (owner: dave_platform)
- sean_sre: document mitigation steps, replay verification steps, and timestamped evidence (owner: sean_sre)
- mariam_cs: coordinate RCA & customer-facing timeline with EnterprizeX (owner: mariam_cs)
- remy_oncall: update incident ticket (INC-2026-0315-149) and keep P1 until verification complete
sara_oncall_eng: handing to remy_oncall for follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: incident status: P1 open -> mitigated, awaiting replay completion and RCA. Thread will receive updates.
lee_oncall: replay complete. Verification shows ~98% trace recovery; a small number of spans dropped due to partial payload loss in the queue.
mariam_cs: EnterprizeX confirms most traces restored, will escalate if they identify anomalies in next 24h. Requested RCA and preventative plan.
sean_sre: preliminary root cause: automated credential rotation job updated role name but the rotation pipeline did not update the trust policy for cross-account forwarder role; partitioned test coverage missed this tenant-specific binding.
remy_oncall: next steps before closure:
- create synthetic monitor for per-tenant ingestion across dedicated pools (DP owners + monitoring)
- extend rotation pipeline tests to include tenant-specific trust policy validation
- add fallback-to-central runbook step and alert on fallback activation
- schedule a replay-drill for dp-42 (non-prod first)
lee_oncall: handoff to night oncall at 02:00 UTC for monitoring; page if any regression.
incidents-bot: incident closed -> awaiting RCA doc. Thread archived after follow-ups.
